title: Permutation test: observed edge differences
description: Two groups of 300 sequences compared edge by edge. Compared here: the two networks and their observed differences, which involve no randomness. The p-values and effect sizes are NOT compared: the two programs draw their permutations differently (tna permutes the sequences, Nestimate permutes precomputed per-sequence counts), so under one seed they are two Monte Carlo estimates of the same quantity, not the same numbers. Both are printed in the raw output.
